lines.text: Many learners say: My mom is nice. He cooks well.
Better: My mom is nice. She cooks well.
Mom is a woman. Use she.

data.wrong: My mom is nice. He cooks well.
data.right: My mom is nice. She cooks well.
data.why: Mom is a woman. Use she.

quiz.stem: My sister is tall. ___ is a nurse.

native.tip: Tiếng Việt dùng “ông/bà/cô…” theo ngữ cảnh. Tiếng Anh dùng he/she theo giới tính.
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “My mom is nice. He cooks well.” không? 😅 Mẹ, chị, cô dùng “she”: “My mom is nice. She cooks well.” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “She”. Nói về người thân bằng he hoặc she cho đúng nhé. Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: Vietnamese picks words by context. English uses he or she by gender.
en.caption: Do you often say “My mom is nice. He cooks well.”? Mom, sister, aunt take “she”: “My mom is nice. She cooks well.” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
